detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Bring the glass to the customer!

As two construction workers, you are transporting a glass window for a tall structure. On this journey you have to be careful with the glass because it is very fragile. Can you make it to the top without breaking it?

Invite a trusted friend to your lobby to carry the glass with you!

Three courses, three difficulties

Climb the Skyscraper, reach the top of the Lighthouse or brave the frozen Frosty course. Normal gives you plenty of checkpoints, Hard gives you fewer and Impossible gives you none at all.

Skyscraper

Cross the city streets and the harbor pier, then climb the skyscraper floor by floor past swinging hammers, rolling red balls, spinning floors and cannons that fire cars, all the way to the top high above the sea.

Lighthouse

Run from the bombs of a pirate ship along the coast, cross a tropical island on rafts, rails and spinning platforms and beat the giant Crab Boss on your way to the top of the lighthouse.

NEW: Frosty, a snowy third course

Collect three golden keys to open the arctic base, hop across sinking lily pads, ride the ski lift, survive the 9 Color game and melt the giant Snowball Boss before you fit the glass into the observatory window.

NEW: 2v2 Glass Race

Two pairs, one course, one winner. Race another team to the finish while the rival pair runs beside you as a ghost you pass straight through.

Play together, your way

  • Online co-op with a friend

  • Local co-op on one PC with gamepads, on a shared screen or split screen

  • Quick chat wheel and built-in voice chat

  • Lost your connection? Rejoin your match within 90 seconds

Characters with physics

Every carrier sways, wobbles and stumbles with physics, while both hands keep their grip on the glass handles, even in jumps and rolls.

Dress up your carrier

The Wardrobe now holds 61 hats, glasses and back items, 33 of them brand new. Try them on in the main menu and show them off.

Chase the best time

  • A speedrun timer that starts on your first move, with splits against your best at every checkpoint

  • 26 Steam achievements

  • Leaderboards for every course

  • Hidden easter eggs on every course

Built for smooth co-op

  • New netcode: your carrier moves instantly and the glass sits in both players' hands on both screens

  • Full gamepad support and full key rebinding

  • A brand new interface that fits any screen, from 4:3 to ultrawide

  • Accessibility options: text and HUD size, color filters, high contrast, reduced motion and sound captions

  • Playable in 13 languages
